comparison.objective: Candidate installs lifting hardware and transfers a load; record presses an add-on PCB onto two header rows without bending pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests pin lock actuation, shackle lifting, load seating, and extraction; record tests parallel multi-pin alignment and even force application under bend-risk constraints.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires mechanical retention, a 30 mm lift, three-pad support, and pin removal; record requires unbent pins, insertion depth, full seating, stillness, and gripper clearance.
comparison.reason: Close-clearance insertion is generic overlap only; the record's defining ability is damage-free multi-pin mating, not load-bearing locking or transfer.
